_meta.description: 感情・表情パターン定義テンプレート。各キャラの expression フィールドを補完する
_meta.usage: SD プロンプトに直接組み込む感情タグとして使用

emotion_to_prompt.joy_subtle: slight smile, soft eyes, relaxed expression
emotion_to_prompt.joy_open: bright smile, happy expression, eyes curved
emotion_to_prompt.joy_euphoric: wide smile, laughing, eyes closed in joy
emotion_to_prompt.sadness_hidden: forced smile, sad eyes, bittersweet expression
emotion_to_prompt.sadness_open: teary eyes, sorrowful expression, downcast gaze
emotion_to_prompt.anger_cold: cold stare, expressionless face, sharp eyes
emotion_to_prompt.anger_hot: furrowed brows, gritted teeth, fierce expression
emotion_to_prompt.fear_mild: worried expression, nervous look, eyebrows raised
emotion_to_prompt.fear_open: wide eyes, pale face, fearful expression
emotion_to_prompt.contempt: smirk, one eyebrow raised, condescending look
emotion_to_prompt.determination: sharp gaze, set jaw, resolute expression
emotion_to_prompt.confusion: tilted head, puzzled look, furrowed brows
emotion_to_prompt.longing: wistful gaze, distant expression, slight frown
emotion_to_prompt.pride: confident smile, chin up, self-satisfied expression
